# Accent `everlast`

Link: `?firma=everlast`

Everlast AI's own site is warm off-white with a lemon-yellow accent. The demo does not copy it: yellow and gold are not used as a main colour here, and an earlier attempt that rebuilt the site's look was dropped. Instead the company gets a calm **indigo**, a cool colour that sits well with an AI consultancy and reads clearly in light and dark mode. No logo, font, image or text of the company is used; the only trace is the small "Demo für Everlast" note in the header.

| Token | Light | Dark | Use |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| accent | `#5148E0` | `#8A84FF` | chart marks, icons, focus ring |
| accent-soft | `#ECEBFD` | `#23213F` | tinted surfaces, icon circles |
| accent-fg | `#4338CA` | `#B3AEFF` | text and links in the accent |
| primary / hover | `#5148E0` / `#453BCF` | same | buttons, the "Zugesagt" card; white text 6.3:1 |
| chart-2 | `#A9A3F3` | `#CFCBFF` | second series |

Contrast for every pair is tested in `tests/unit/theme.test.ts`.
